b'# tinydl

A tiny command line downloader.

## Usage

```
tinydl URL [options]
```

## Command Line Options

| Option | Help Text |
| --- | --- |
| `url` | what to download |
| `-o`, `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no progress output |

### Positional Arguments

- `url` \xe2\x80\x94 what to download

### Optional Arguments

- `-o`, `--output FILE` \xe2\x80\x94 file to write (default: stdout)
- `-q`, `--quiet` \xe2\x80\x94 no progress output

## Example

```
tinydl https://example.com/file.bin -o file.bin
```
'
